plan.purpose: Exploratory registration/delete lifecycle matrix to detect allocation-compaction costs excluded from steady lookup workload
plan.safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
plan.memory: Separate retained/peak requested heap diagnostic; per-cycle lifetime cleanup checked. Proc before/after retained in raw data only.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
plan.analysis: Four exploratory randomized paired blocks; per-cycle latency includes same client encoding, ADD_OBJECT, REMOVE_OBJECT. Full signature preflight and final empty lookup outside timed/CPU interval. Failed validation invalidates window; no superiority verdict.
plan.hypothesis: Removing temporary and retained method-name allocations may offset boxed-list shrinking. Measure full add/remove lifecycle and report all adverse directions.
plan.retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. Do not claim full superiority or promote this runtime change on pilot point estimates alone. Report all latency/CPU signs, memory diagnostics, and allocation-only evidence separately. Investigate apparent new regressions before retaining.
plan.build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
plan.client_control: ca1a912 client and dependencies plus frozen CPU-clock patch and register-cycle command; one identical new client for all registration arms. Do not pool with lookup experiment.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 4 lanes; object counts (0,)
